register_rows.description: The count metrics count distinct (entry, id) findings (W15-14); this is the number of register rows behind the same metric; null for a metric that counts entries or is a share or magnitude. Computed by riskvalidation.governance.appetite.appetite_metrics.

appMetric.description: One B.6 metric (06 l.606-612) with its value, unit, numerator, denominator and its light under a stated threshold.

appThreshold.description: The stated threshold of a light: a convention with its basis (item 30), never a regulatory value.

reduction.description: 1 - |mean bias of the rung| / |mean bias of the accepted-only model|, with its paired bootstrap interval; 0 for the accepted-only model itself.

auc_vs_accepted_only.description: Paired difference of the AUC on the accept-all population against the accepted-only model.

reliability_raw.description: The same with the six-month full payers as transactors (the cards only; null for the loans).

targets.description: The observed outcome of each sampled applicant (1 = default).

reject_inference.description: S-6, reject inference on a simulated legacy policy: carried by the German twin, null on every other variant.

anytime_p_value.description: min(1, 1 / sup E): valid at any stopping time.

c03SeqPath.description: The e-process of the cohort under one combination of its vintages.

months_observed.description: Months of age observed for the vintage (a multiple of the age step).

defaults.description: Charge-offs in the observed age intervals (whole loans).

predicted_defaults.description: The sum over the observed intervals of the vintage's loans times the predicted interval PD.

rejection_month.description: The first age at which this vintage's own e-process reached the threshold.

five_year_light.description: The light of the champion's binomial row on this vintage at the 5-year mark; null when the mark is not observed.

months_before_the_mark.description: The months between the rejection and the last age; null when the vintage never rejected.

c03SeqVintage.description: One vintage as a grade of the cohort's e-process, set beside the fixed-window reading at the 5-year mark.

threshold.description: 1 / alpha_level: the value the process must reach to reject.

training_mean_5y_pd.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c03Stability.description: Population stability of each test vintage against the training window and its observed 5-year rate against the training mean (the crisis contrast).

anyOf.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

horizon_months.description: Months from approval over which a charge-off counts: the 5-year target.

observed_at_months.description: The target is read for a vintage only at its 5-year mark (60 months after its last approval).

c03Target.description: The 5-year charge-off target and how loans without an observed outcome (EXEMPT, still active) are handled.

observed_cumulative_pd.description: Null where the horizon is beyond the observation cutoff.

observed_until_month.description: Months from the last approval of the vintage to files_as_of.

c03VintageCurve.description: The predicted and the observed cumulative charge-off PD of one approval-year vintage.

c04AnchorCohortRow.description: One grade of one annual cohort: the fields of c04AnchorRow and the cohort's label.

anyOf.description: The k at which the grade's PD(k) reaches the master-scale boundary to the next grade (the geometric mean of their industry PDs).

c04AnchorRow.description: One grade of the pooled cohorts: the transition page's defaults D, survivors S and withdrawals W against the default page's defaults A over its cohort Na; the PD of the usual estimate, of the default page, the anchored k with its band (None where it is not defined; `infinite` names the ones that are infinite) and the anchored PD with its interval.

c04Bounds.description: None for a grade without ratings, and for tab 3's events where they outnumber the cohort.

c04BoundsVerdict.description: BS-14's hypothesis (i) read off the rungs' coverage of one grade's true PD against the criteria fixed before the run (the anchored interval covers at least 90% at informative 1, 3 and 9; the existing treatments under 50% at 9; refuted if the anchored interval does not cover more than every existing treatment at 9).

pd.description: Closed at 0 on purpose: the capital parity grid includes PD 0 (a grade with no default in any cohort), an engine input that probes the 0.05% floor of CRE32.4 and is not an estimated PD (data-pipeline/pipeline/cases/c04_parity.py:67-69, 154-160).

c04Cohort.description: One CEREP cohort on the common scale: tab 4's counts (seven grades by seven grades and default), withdrawals and sizes; tab 2's defaulted ratings over its own cohort; tab 3's events. Semester cohorts have no tab 2 or tab 3.

c04Generator.description: A generator of the pooled matrix: its rates, its L1 distance to the matrix, its PDs at one and five years (null by grade where the scale has no default category, Moody's).

c04Lifetime.description: One five-year window of the lifetime check (CT-415): the fixed cohort observed at the window's end against the chained one-year projections; a value is null where the chain or the definition does not exist.

c04Lra.description: The long-run average default rate by grade (EBA/GL/2017/16 paragraph 84) under one definition.

rate.description: null for a grade without a defined rate in any cohort

c04Performance.description: riskvalidation's estimator performance of a quantity by grade (Morris et al. 2019, Table 6): null by grade where fewer than two repetitions are defined.

c04Print.description: A printed value beside its recomputation; the bake stops unless they agree (contract section 3).

c04ProjectionPoint.description: The live parity of C04's models artifact (contract section 4), and the families' generator.

c04Rate.description: A harness rate: rejections (or hits) over n repetitions with its Monte Carlo SE and Wilson interval.

c04ScalarPerformance.description: The same for one quantity per repetition (the momentum hazard's fitted coefficient).

c04WithdrawalAnchorStudy.description: BS-14: the default page (tab 2) as the anchor of the transition page's withdrawals (tab 4), per grade, annual cohorts and pooled; None where the transition page has no default category.

c04WithdrawalBounds.description: BS-14 (riskvalidation.transitions.withdrawals): the coverage of the true one-year PD by grade of the existing treatments of withdrawn ratings and of the anchored interval, over the rung's own draws, in four designs (first year, five cohorts pooled, a second source that counts 70% of the defaults, ten times the cohort).

c06AccountCurve.description: The SICR view's pair of curves for a sampled account: the origination forward curve against the current one over the same remaining window.

residual.description: closing - (opening + sum of movements) itself (a document may store it rounded to 1e-9); closure is judged against the reconciliation tolerance basis.

c06DataStatus.description: The data this document stands on. A variant without Freddie Mac data says so and why; nothing is invented.

c06DecileCalibration.description: Calibration at 12, 24 and 36 months per predicted-risk decile against the observed cumulative incidence (SDD row Lifetime PD rungs); an unobserved cell is null with its reason.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06EclByScenario.description: Per-scenario ECL by stage at 100 per cent weight, model ECL without overlays. Staging is frozen: it is computed once at the weighted conditions and applied to every scenario row, so the weighted ECL equals the sum of weight times scenario ECL.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06Fit.description: C06 fit: segments, the Fed-style scenario definitions, the TTC to PIT conversion, the lifetime PD ladder, LGD, EAD and the staging policy that the bake used.

amount.description: Signed; a positive amount raises the gross carrying amount.

residual.description: closing - (opening + sum of movements) itself (a document may store it rounded to 1e-9); closure is judged against the reconciliation tolerance basis.

origination_cohort.description: The origination cohort of the row (for example `2018`), or `all` for the pooled originations.

estimator.description: Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence when prepayment competes, Kaplan-Meier otherwise.

c06LifetimeBacktest.description: Observed against predicted cumulative default by origination cohort and horizon (Aalen-Johansen when prepayment competes, Kaplan-Meier otherwise); a horizon not yet observed is null with its reason.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06NonLinearity.description: The non-linearity panel: PD_PIT(z), the weighted PD against the PD at the weighted-average factor, and NL = ECL_weighted / ECL(mean path) - 1.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

scenarios.description: At least two probability-weighted scenarios (IFRS 9 5.5.17(a), B5.5.42); weights sum to 1.

c06Outputs.description: C06 reporting-date outputs (outputs.kind reporting-date): one reporting date of the lifetime PD, staging and ECL run. Money in `currency`; PD open (0, 1); horizons in months. A value the bake may lack is nullable with its reason. Staging parameters have one source, `settings` (the C06 models `staging_policy` repeats it field by field). Money identities of the reconciliation close by one tolerance basis (see `reconciliation`).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

stage.description: The stage whose allowance closing carries the overlay; null is portfolio level and is carried in the stage1 closing (a convention of the engine contract).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

tolerance.description: Relative: every identity closes when its absolute difference is at most tolerance * max(1, G), G being the total gross carrying amount of this document (the sum of the absolute closing amounts of `gross_carrying_amount`), in `currency`.

c06Reconciliation.description: IFRS 7 35H (allowance) and 35I (gross carrying amount) roll-forwards by stage; opening plus movements equals closing and residual is within the tolerance basis max(1, G) * tolerance (G the total gross carrying amount of the document). Each allowance `line_id` is a waterfall line id; each stage allowance closing equals the stage ECL plus the overlays carried in that stage.

eir_basis.description: The EIR basis of every non-POCI account; POCI accounts always use the credit-adjusted EIR (IFRS 9 5.5.13), whatever this value.

default_dpd.description: Days past due at which an account is Stage 3 (dpd >= default_dpd; the 90 dpd presumption of IFRS 9 B5.5.37).

low_credit_risk_pd.description: Annualised PD at or below which the quantitative SICR tests are suppressed (5.5.10); null when no exemption is used (then `low_credit_risk_exemption` is false). It never suppresses the dpd backstop, forbearance, watch-list, collective or default triggers.

sicr.description: The staging policy record (engine StagingPolicy). Only the 30 dpd and 90 dpd presumptions are IFRS 9; the threefold ratio is an EBA supervisory expectation; the rest are Contraste policy parameters.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

flows.description: A POCI account stays POCI for its life: a flow out of poci ends in derecognised or written-off.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06StagingPolicy.description: The staging policy of the fit. The variant `outputs.settings.sicr` (with `settings.probation_months`) is authoritative: this block equals it field by field, and `low_credit_risk_pd` is null exactly when `low_credit_risk_exemption` is false.

c06TermStructure.description: h(t), q(t) = S(t-1) h(t) and F(t) = sum q, per scenario ('weighted' for the probability-weighted curve) and segment; the arrays are aligned with months and F is strictly increasing.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06Waterfall.description: Opening to closing allowance. A positive amount raises the allowance and a negative amount lowers it; the opening line is the sum of the stage openings, every movement line is the sum over the stages of the reconciliation movements with the same `line_id`, and the closing line is the sum of the stage closings. Every overlay is its own line (kind overlay, overlay_id set, id `overlay-<overlay id>`), never merged into a model line.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06WeightGrid.description: The scenario-weight simplex: ECL and the Stage 2 ratio with staging recomputed against staging frozen; each weights vector is aligned with scenario_ids and sums to 1.

minimum_check.description: The 0.50 per cent minimum on the individually assessed normal portfolio (categories A1 to A6), loans plus contingent credits; top_up is carried in regimes[cmf-b1] as the line minimum-top-up.

internal.description: The internal-method provision; null when the bank has no internal method (then internal_reason is set and method is standard).

additional_provisions.description: Counter-cyclical general provisions (B-1 N 9): their own line, outside the comparable total and never per segment.

booked_total.description: What the bank books under B-1: the comparable total plus the additional provisions.

c07B1Table.description: A transcribed CMF CNCB B-1 table; PI, PDI and PE are decimals (0.010916 is 1.0916 per cent) and, where both are set, PE = PI x PDI to the table's rounding. Closed at 0 and 1 on purpose: the default column is PI = 1 and the tables are statutory parameters, not estimates.

coverage_rate.description: provision divided by the exposure of the category.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

rows.description: Segment provisions of the model only (by_segment); the unallocated lines are in `unallocated`.

unallocated.description: The sums of the unallocated lines of each regime; rows plus unallocated equal the regime totals.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.
ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

calibration_source.description: Where the bank's calibration comes from, a bilingual text from c07-models 3.0.0 (an English string in a document baked before).

source.description: The publication, locator, URL and file hash of the target, a bilingual text from c07-models 3.0.0 (an English string in a document baked before).

bde_segment.description: The Annex 9 segment code; the label is separate.

weighting_scenarios.description: At least two outcomes with weights summing to 1 (5.5.17(a), B5.5.42); the IFRS 9 regime of every variant is the weighted ECL over them.

eir_basis.description: EIR basis of the non-POCI accounts; POCI accounts use the credit-adjusted EIR.

doubtful_bucket_upper_days.description: Inclusive upper bound in days of each doubtful bucket (months at 30.4375 days rounded); null for the last, open bucket.

z_shift.description: The variant's shift of current conditions in systematic-factor units, added to every weighting scenario; 0 for base.

c07Fit.description: C07 fit: the synthetic Banco Andino calibration, the transcribed B-1 tables with their cells, the IFRS 9 parameters, the BdE Annex 9 coverage and the six scenario definitions.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c07GapBridge.description: The gap from the CMF B-1 comparable total to the IFRS 9 total (both as defined on `total_provision`) as exhaustive steps whose amounts sum to the gap exactly (an unexplained step is its own line). B-1 additional provisions are outside both totals and are not a step; the B-1 minimum top-up and the IFRS 9 overlays are.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

stage_summary.description: Model ECL excluding overlays, by stage.

overlays_total.description: Sum of overlays[].amount; regimes[ifrs9].total_provision = model ECL + overlays_total.

z.description: The systematic factor of the component: its weighting-scenario offset plus the variant shift.

single_scenario_ecl.description: A component of the weighted measure at 100 per cent weight; a sensitivity, never the IFRS 9 measure.

weighted_components.description: At least two scenarios whose weights sum to 1; the model ECL is the sum of weight times single_scenario_ecl (5.5.17(a), B5.5.42).

overlays.description: Each overlay is its own line, also an unallocated line of regimes[ifrs9]; never merged into by_segment or stage_summary.

c11-variant-window.title: C11 window variant
c11-variant-window.description: Catalog row c11-outputs 3.0.0: one window of the market VaR and ES back-testing case (outputs.kind window), strictly rolling, on public daily series.

c11Champion.description: The champion at a level: the lowest average FZ0 among the eligible models with a score; null, with its reason, when there is none.

hac_lags.description: The lag count of every Diebold-Mariano row: 0 for one-step forecasts (engine contract, scoring.diebold_mariano).

c11Comparison.description: Eligibility first, then the comparative back-test of Nolde and Ziegel: DM against the champion and the MCS.

transform.description: How the series becomes a return of the portfolio (a log return, a duration times a yield change).

c11Component.description: A component of the window's stated portfolio and the licence class of its source (dossier 08 C.5, C.2, C.8).

c11Conformal.description: BS-16, the beyond tier: the engine's adaptive conformal wrapper around HS-250, GARCH-t and FHS, wrapped against unwrapped in this window.

c11ConformalCell.description: One model at one level over the three stress windows: windows passed without and with the wrapper, and the worst FZ0 change.

c11ConformalHypothesis.description: The plan's hypothesis of BS-16 with its measured cells and its verdict, the same in every window document.

anyOf.description: A probability in [0, 1].

fz0_change.description: (wrapped FZ0 minus unwrapped FZ0) over the absolute unwrapped FZ0: positive is worse.

n_clipped.description: Days on which the update of the working level was cut by the band.

c11ConformalRow.description: One wrapped model at one tail level in this window, beside the same model unwrapped.

hit_rate.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

anyOf.description: A probability in [0, 1].
A probability in [0, 1].
A probability in [0, 1].
A probability in [0, 1].

fz0_mean.description: Average FZ0 loss over the window; null when an ES is not finite.

z2.description: The engine's Z2 statistic, 1 minus the mean of loss over ES on the hit days, over alpha: 0 under a correct ES, negative when the ES is understated.

ladder_rank.description: 1 plus the number of ladder models with a lower average FZ0 at the level.

c11ConformalScore.description: The back-test and score reading of one VaR and ES sequence: the engine's coverage tests, the Acerbi-Szekely test against the ladder's null, FZ0 and Z2.

working_level.description: The working tail level on each grid day.

items.description: A positive loss number (document convention) as a decimal of the portfolio value.
A positive loss number (document convention) as a decimal of the portfolio value.

c11ConformalSeries.description: The wrapped model's path: its working level, its VaR and ES (positive losses) and the days the loss exceeded the VaR.

mean_diff.description: Mean loss differential, model minus champion, on the common sample: negative is better.

anyOf.description: A probability in [0, 1].

n_common.description: Days where every compared forecast is defined.

c11DmRow.description: A Diebold-Mariano comparison of one model against the champion (dossier 05 B.6) under FZ0 or the tick loss.

critical_5pct.description: Simulated per model: Z2 at the 5 percent quantile of the null (yellow).

critical_0_01pct.description: Simulated per model: Z2 at the 0.01 percent quantile of the null (red).

c11EsNull.description: The simulated null distribution of the Acerbi-Szekely Z2 for one model, with the realised statistic (dossier 05 B.5).

c11EsReference.description: The published reference points of Acerbi and Szekely for Z2 (dossier 05 B.5): a reference, never a regulatory threshold; each model's own simulated critical values are in the outputs.

c11Fit.description: The C11 models document: the six windows, the ladder, the bands and the reference points the views draw.

c11Gate.description: An eligibility gate: the model is ineligible when the row of this test is red at any level.

estimation_window_days.description: The maximum look-back, in observed days; each rung's own window is in the models document.

dates.description: The forecast days, strictly increasing, missing days skipped.

estimation_start.description: First day of the estimation window of each forecast day.

estimation_end.description: Last day of the estimation window of each forecast day: strictly before the forecast day (the forecast for day t uses data to t-1; a producer check, since a date comparison is not a JSON Schema rule).

c11Grid.description: The forecast grid shared by every model: dates once, the estimation window of each day, the realised losses.

c11Hyperparameters.description: The hyperparameters (window length, lambda, EVT threshold fraction) fixed on the span, never tuned on a test window.

c11Level.description: A tail level of the return convention: 0.01 (99 percent VaR, the Basel level) or 0.025 (97.5 percent, the FRTB ES level).

items.description: A positive loss number (document convention) as a decimal of the portfolio value.

var.description: One-step VaR forecast per grid day, a positive loss.

anyOf.description: A positive loss number (document convention) as a decimal of the portfolio value.

es.description: One-step ES forecast per grid day, a positive loss not below the VaR; null on a day the ES is undefined (conditional EVT with xi at or above 1) or for a model that forecasts no ES.

es_undefined_days.description: Indices into the grid of the days the ES is undefined.

exceedance_days.description: Indices into the grid of the days the loss exceeded the VaR.

n_fz0.description: Days with both VaR and ES defined: the sample of the FZ0 average.

fz0_mean.description: Average FZ0 loss (dossier 05 A.1) over the n_fz0 days; null when no day has an ES.

tick_loss_mean.description: Average tick loss of the VaR over the n_scored days.

test_ids.description: The test rows of this model and level (segment alpha=<alpha>).

c11LevelResult.description: One model at one tail level: its forecasts, exceedances, scores and traffic light.

c11McsSet.description: The model confidence set on FZ0 at one level (Hansen, Lunde and Nason 2011; dossier 05 B.6).

c11MissingDays.description: A day missing from a public series (a holiday, a gap) is skipped in the rolling window and counted here, never filled.

c11ModelOutput.description: One model of the ladder in this window; eligible when no eligibility-gate row is red (the traditional back-tests of dossier 05 'Champion selection rule').

conformal.description: BS-16, the beyond tier; null in a partial bake that leaves the ladder without the three wrapped models.

c11Outputs.description: The C11 window document: market VaR and ES forecasts of the ladder, strictly rolling, and their back-tests.

c11Parameter.description: A fitted parameter across the refits of a window: minimum, median and maximum.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the portfolio.

c11Portfolio.description: The portfolio stated for the window; returns and losses are decimals of its value.

c11Realised.description: The realised loss per forecast day (positive number, a decimal of the portfolio value). Withheld, with its reason, when a component of the portfolio is derived-only (dossier 08 C.5: only model outputs are committed).

source.description: The primary source of the method (dossier 05 A.2).

c11Rung.description: A rung of the market ladder (dossier 05 'Method ladders': rungs 1 to 10; rung 10 is a challenger only).

c11SignConvention.description: The sign convention, a required field of every C11 document (dossier 05 A.0): the engine stores the return convention (VaR and ES negative at the tail level alpha 0.01 or 0.025, needed by the FZ0 loss) and the document stores positive loss numbers, the conversion made once at the reporting layer. The definition states both in words.

c11Span.description: The span on which the hyperparameters were fixed (decision D1): 1995-01-01 to 2003-12-31 for every window, so it ends before the earliest test window (calm 2004-06) and tunes on none.

c11TrafficLight.description: The Basel traffic light at the 99 percent level over rolling 250-day windows (MAR32.9): the zone of each complete window and the days spent in each zone. With fewer than 250 forecast days it is not evaluated, with its reason.

exceptions.description: The number of exceptions in 250 days; 10 stands for ten or more.

frtb_multiplier.description: The backtesting-dependent multiplier m_c of MAR32.9 Table 1.

us_multiplier.description: The US multiplication factor of 12 CFR 217.204 Table 1 (dossier 05 B.4).

cumulative_probability_pct.description: P(X <= exceptions), X ~ Bin(250, 0.01), in percent (MAR32.9 Table 1).

c11TrafficTable.description: MAR32.9 Table 1 with the US factors (dossier 01 D.4, dossier 05 B.4); the reference for every traffic-light band.

c11Window.description: One of the six windows of SDD C11 with the dates of decision D2; the variant id is the window id.

c11WindowPlan.description: A window with the dates of decision D2 and the span of decision D1 on which its hyperparameters were fixed.

c12-models.title: C12 models (HW1F calibration per backtest date)
c12-models.description: The C12 models document: the Hull-White one-factor calibration per backtest date with its sample window, the counterparty curve, the transcribed GIRR parameters and the stated limits.

c12-variant-swap-exposure.title: C12 variant (swap exposure, CVA and SA-CCR)
c12-variant-swap-exposure.description: One variant of case C12 (swap exposure, CVA and SA-CCR): the six SDD variants share this schema and are told apart by outputs.variant. Every object is closed and nothing is optional; a block a variant does not run is null.

c12BaCva.description: The BA-CVA reduced block: sector, rating, EAD, M, DF, SCVA, K_reduced and the capital DS x K_reduced. No official numeric example is verified (B8); the limit says so.

c12BaCvaCounterparty.description: One counterparty of the BA-CVA reduced approach (MAR50.14 to MAR50.16 Table 1).

calibration_rule.const: each initialisation date is calibrated on data up to that date only

sub_windows.description: before 2008, 2008 to 2019, from 2020, in that order.

c12Backtest.description: The PIT-based exposure backtest (B5): the book revalued on the realised curves, and the risk factor (the short-rate proxy) backtested as well (BCBS 185 paragraph 20).

c12BacktestHorizon.description: The PIT backtest at one horizon: the PITs, the Anderson-Darling W^2 against the critical values simulated under the model itself (same dates, overlapping horizons) with the iid table values beside them, the effective sample size and several PFE percentiles (BCBS 185 paragraph 31).

c12BacktestHorizons.description: The six horizons in order: 10 and 20 business days, 1, 3, 6 and 12 months.

c12Book.description: The synthetic book of the variant: one swap for the single-swap variant and at least two for the netting set.

estimator.const: exact AR(1) OLS on the shortest Treasury zero rate (Brigo et al., arXiv 0812.4210, equations 55 to 57)

history_years.description: At least three years of history (CRE53.51).

fit_to_curve.const: phi(t) = f(0,t) + sigma^2 (1 - exp(-a t))^2 / (2 a^2), the QuantLib 1.44 fitting parameter

c12Calibration.description: The Hull-White one-factor calibration at one backtest date: a and sigma from the history only, the fit to the curve of the date by phi(t). The sample window ends strictly before the backtest date (no look-ahead: a producer check).

c12Collateral.description: The variation-margin variant: the CSA terms, the uncollateralised EE on the same axis and the mean collateral balance. The limit states what the close-out model leaves out (the Andersen, Pykhtin and Sokol timelines).

c12Convention.description: A named parameter of the synthetic book or of a method (decision D6): its value, its unit and the label "convention". A parameter without the label fails.

base.const: US Treasury HQM corporate spot curve minus the Treasury zero curve of the same date

negative_spread_rule.const: a negative HQM-minus-Treasury spread is set to zero and counted, never carried as a negative spread

c12CreditCurve.description: The counterparty curve (B10): a derived AAA to A market spread, labelled a proxy; the synthetic spread stays for the BA-CVA rating and the sensitivity rows.

c12Csa.description: The CSA terms of the variant (ORE credit support amount and delivery amount equations, R3).

source.const: US Treasury daily par yield curve (home.treasury.gov)

c12Curve.description: The curve of the curve date. A Treasury tenor absent on that date is absent from the curve and listed in tenors_absent, with the tenors present stated, never interpolated silently.

c12CurvePoint.description: One tenor of the curve: the source par yield (decimal) and the continuously compounded zero rate.

credit_curve_label.const: proxy: an AAA to A market spread, a floor for lower ratings (R10)

negative_spread_rule.const: a negative HQM-minus-Treasury spread is set to zero and counted in spreads_floored_at_zero

c12Cva.description: CVA and DVA by the discretised formula, with the bucket terms so a view or a test recomputes them from the EE.

c12CvaBucket.description: One time bucket of the discretised CVA: PD x LGD x discounted EPE (dossier 05 C.2).

c12Exceedance.description: The exceedances of the PFE at one quantile (a secondary row, BCBS 185 paragraph 27).

c12Exposure.description: The exposure measures of the variant on the time grid, each with its Monte Carlo error: EE and ENE undiscounted (Basel style, dossier 05 C.1) and discounted under the numeraire (the CVA input), the PFE at the stated quantile, the effective EE (running maximum, CRE53.12) and EEPE (CRE53.13) over the first year or to maturity.

anyOf.const: exact AR(1) OLS on the shortest Treasury zero rate (Brigo et al., arXiv 0812.4210, equations 55 to 57)

estimator.description: The estimator as the views print it, a bilingual text (c12-models 2.0.0); the English sentence alone in a document baked before 2.0.0.

closed_forms_status.const: formulas transcribed from the engine source; the journal derivations are UNVERIFIED as papers

c12Fit.description: The HW1F calibration per backtest date with its sample window (which ends before the date), the counterparty curve, the GIRR parameters and the stated limits of the case. The calibration dates are unique and increasing.

sensitivities.description: s_k = (V(r + 0.0001) - V(r)) / 0.0001 at each GIRR tenor, in USD per unit of rate: the change in value for a 1 basis point shift divided by 0.0001 (MAR21.19), not the PV01 per basis point. The weighted sensitivity is RW_k s_k / sqrt(2).

c12GirrCharge.description: The FRTB SA GIRR delta charge of the same book (single USD bucket): the sensitivities s_k per tenor as MAR21.19 defines them, the weighted sensitivities with the MAR21.44 division by sqrt(2) (a named convention) and the charge, the maximum over the three correlation scenarios, with the undivided charge beside it.

tenors_years.description: The ten GIRR delta tenors of MAR21.8.

risk_weights.description: MAR21.42 Table 1, in the order of the tenors.

correlation_percent.description: MAR21.46 Table 2 (percent): the table is the primary value, the formula max(exp(-0.03 |Tk - Tl| / min(Tk, Tl)), 40%) a reconstructed check.

c12GirrParameters.description: The GIRR parameters of the addendum's R7, transcribed. A swap book has no vega, so the vega formula of footnote 24 is not needed and not transcribed.

c12GirrScenario.description: The bucket charge under one correlation scenario (MAR21.6).

method.const: ORE dynamic initial margin by regression (R2)

c12Im.description: Initial margin as a separate balance: DIM(t) = alpha S(t) sqrt(horizon / MPoR) applied as max(exposure - DIM, 0), alpha the normal quantile of `quantile`, the horizon and the MPoR in calendar days as ORE computes horizonCalendarDays / mporCalendarDays (10 business days are 14 calendar days, 20 are 28). Labelled a regression proxy, never SIMM (SIMM is not used: its public notice restricts use to a participant's own transactions).

c12Money.description: An amount of money with its currency code.

c12MoneySe.description: An amount of money with its currency code and its Monte Carlo standard error.

c12NamedParameters.description: Every named parameter, required, each with its value and the label convention.

c12NettingBenefit.description: The netting benefit: the netting-set EE is at most the sum of the single-trade EE; the benefit is their difference.

values.description: One non-negative value per point of the time grid.

mc_se.description: The Monte Carlo standard error of each value.

c12NonNegProfile.description: A non-negative money profile (an EE, ENE, PFE, effective EE or DIM) on the time grid with its Monte Carlo standard errors (same length as the grid: a producer check).

c12OreReconciliation.description: The reconciliation of the Python measures against ORE 1.8.17.0 on the same curve and model parameters (ADR-0069: the bake's): the EE profile at every grid point, the EEPE and the CVA recomputed from the ORE profiles, and for the initial-margin variant the DIM profile, each with its agreement. Every variant but the wrong-way one is reconciled (S2); the wrong-way one is not-applicable with its reason. An ORE run that fails stops the bake: a variant is never published as not-applicable because ORE failed.

c12Outputs.description: The outputs of one C12 variant: the book, the curve, the calibration, the exposure measures, CVA and DVA, the regulatory measures, the backtest and the ORE reconciliation.

c12Pit.description: A PIT value in (0, 1) by the (i + 1) / (N + 2) rule.

c12PointAgreement.description: The agreement at one grid point: the difference ORE minus Python, the combined Monte Carlo standard error and whether the difference is within two of them.

values.description: One value per point of the time grid.

mc_se.description: The Monte Carlo standard error of each value.

c12Profile.description: A money profile on the time grid with its Monte Carlo standard errors (same length as the grid: a producer check).

c12Regulatory.description: The regulatory measures beside the modelled ones: alpha times EEPE (CRE53.11) against the SA-CCR EAD, the effective maturity M of CRE53.20 (capped at 5 years) and the stressed Effective EPE.

c12SaAddOns.description: The add-on by asset class (CRE52.24 to CRE52.25).

c12SaCcr.description: The SA-CCR block (CRE52): the trade inputs and every intermediate value, RC, the hedging sets with buckets B1 to B3, the effective notionals, the add-ons, the multiplier and EAD = 1.4 (RC + PFE), so a live port is checked step by step.

c12SaHedgingSet.description: An interest rate hedging set (one per currency): the bucket effective notionals D(B1) to D(B3), the offset or no-offset formula of CRE52.57, the effective notional EN and AddOn = SF x EN.

c12SaTrade.description: The CRE52 intermediates of one trade: supervisory duration (CRE52.34), adjusted notional, supervisory delta, maturity factor (CRE52.48 to CRE52.52), the maturity bucket of its end date (CRE52.57) and the effective notional d x delta x MF.

c12ScalarAgreement.description: The agreement of one scalar (EEPE or CVA): the Python value, the ORE value, their difference (ORE minus Python), the combined standard error and the two-standard-error flag.

c12SensitivityCase.description: EE and PFE (the profiles and their summaries) under the base calibration and with a and sigma moved by one standard error (B6).

c12Sign.description: Sign convention, stated in the document: EE is the positive exposure to the counterparty, ENE the bank's own, CVA a positive cost and DVA a positive benefit.

c12StressedEpe.description: The stressed Effective EPE (B9): a named three-year window containing a stress period, and the HQM spread rising in it (B10).

c12SubWindow.description: One reporting sub-window of the backtest (D7).

c12SubWindowResult.description: W^2 of one horizon in a sub-window.

floating_leg.const: USD floating leg on the single curve of the case

c12Trade.description: One fixed-for-floating USD interest rate swap: payer pays the fixed rate. Its terms are conventions.

money.const: amount with its ISO 4217 currency code, USD in this case

c12Units.description: Units of every number: money in USD with its currency code, rates as decimals discounted continuously, times in years from the valuation date, the margin period of risk in business days, dates ISO.

model.const: Hull and White (2012) hazard rate on the portfolio value, h(t) = exp(a(t) + b w(t))

b_unit.const: per USD million of portfolio value

w_max_usd_million.description: The largest portfolio value of the simulated paths, in USD million.

largest_b_w.description: max |b| of the grid times w_max_usd_million: the largest exponent b w the grid reaches on this book, so the reader sees whether the sweep moves the hazard.

c12Wwr.description: The wrong-way risk variant (B1): CVA over the grid of b, a(t) calibrated sequentially on the simulated paths to the survival curve. b = 0 equals the independent CVA exactly. ORE's wrong-way example is a different model, so this variant has no ORE reconciliation and says so.

c12WwrPoint.description: CVA at one value of the dependence parameter b, with the largest calibration error of the survival constraint; independent is true at b = 0 only.

c13-models.title: C13 models
c13-models.description: Catalog row c13-models 1.0.0: the C13 models artifact (generator, the six planted deficiencies, the PLA thresholds, the desk limits).

c13-variant-deficiency.title: C13 deficiency variant
c13-variant-deficiency.description: Catalog row c13-outputs 3.0.0: one planted model deficiency of the FRTB desk eligibility case (outputs.kind deficiency), on a generator whose truth is known.

c13Complement.description: BS-13, beyond the state of the art: the engine's scale-and-level complement to the PLA test, calibrated on a simulated null, with its flags on this variant, the verdict of the plan's hypothesis (stale-volatility only) and the lag ladder (stale-volatility only). Added to the regulatory zone, never substituted for it.

c13ComplementThresholds.description: The critical values of the complement: the Wald statistic flags above its value, the two Spearman statistics below theirs.

c13DeficiencyPlan.description: One planted deficiency and how the generator plants it.

share_over_limit.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c13DeskLevel.description: Desk back-testing at one level (MAR32.18 to 19): the exception count over 250 days against the limit (more than 12 at 99 percent or 30 at 97.5 percent moves the desk to the standardised approach).

share_amber_or_red.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

share_red.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

mc_se.description: The Monte Carlo standard error of share_amber_or_red.

ci_low.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

ci_high.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

intended_test_flagged.description: Replications where the intended test flagged the desk; null when none was planted.

c13Detection.description: The rate at which the PLA catches the planted deficiency: its power; with no deficiency planted it is the false-alarm rate, the size.

c13Dist.description: The distribution of a statistic across the replications.

hpl.description: 250 daily HPL values, decimals of the notional.

rtpl.description: 250 daily RTPL values, decimals of the notional.

c13Example.description: One replication kept whole, for the rank scatter and the two ECDFs with the KS gap.

c13Fit.description: The C13 models document: the generator, the six deficiencies it plants, the PLA and desk limits.

c13Generator.description: The desk P&L generator with a known risk model; synthetic, labelled so on every view.

c13GeneratorSpec.description: The desk P&L generator with a known risk model.

c13Known.description: The deficiency the generator planted in the desk's risk model: the known truth of the case, a required field.

c13Outputs.description: The C13 deficiency document: the PLA and desk back-test of a desk whose model has one known planted deficiency.

c13PlaThresholds.description: The zone boundaries of MAR32.42 and the ECDF step of MAR32.39 to 41 (dossier 01 D.4), transcribed.

c13PnlSummary.description: A summary of the desk's hypothetical (HPL) or risk-theoretical (RTPL) P&L, median across replications, decimals of the notional.

c13Rate.description: A count of flagged replications out of n, its rate and its 95 percent Wilson interval.

c13SignConvention.description: The sign convention, a required field of every C13 document (dossier 05 A.0): the engine stores the return convention (VaR and ES negative at the tail level alpha 0.01 or 0.025, needed by the FZ0 loss) and the document stores positive loss numbers, the conversion made once at the reporting layer. The definition states both in words.

c13Zones.description: The PLA zone counts across replications: of the joint MAR32.42 zone, of the Spearman statistic alone and of the KS statistic alone.

c14-models.title: C14 models
c14-models.description: Catalog row c14-models 1.0.0: the C14 models artifact (buckets, the 2024 and 2016 shock tables, shapes, NMD caps, multipliers, replicating portfolios, parameter-change flags).

c14-variant-valuation-date.title: C14 valuation-date variant
c14-variant-valuation-date.description: Catalog row c14-outputs 1.0.0: one valuation date of the IRRBB case on a USD balance sheet (outputs.kind valuation-date), real FDIC aggregates and synthetic behaviour.

c14Assumption.description: A behavioural assumption as a named field: its value, its unit and where it comes from (the regulatory cap, a fit, or a stated synthetic value), so a view can show the result with and without it.

c14Assumptions.description: The five behavioural assumptions. nmd_core_share and nmd_core_maturity_years are the balance-weighted averages of nmd_segments.

total_assets.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

total_liabilities.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14BalanceSheet.description: The slotted balance sheet of the valuation date.

c14Bank.description: The bank of the case (real FDIC aggregates, synthetic behaviour: SDD section 5).

c14BsAssumption.description: The balance-sheet assumption of the projection: a constant balance sheet (maturing or repricing flows replaced by identical new ones, DIS70.5) or an annual growth.

bucket.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).

midpoint_years.description: Bucket midpoint in years: one of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3.

c14BucketDef.description: One of the 19 time buckets of SRP31.96 Table 3.

delta_eve_behavioural.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_eve_contractual.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

difference.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14Comparison.description: Delta EVE with and without the behavioural NMD assumptions, always reported (dossier 05 D.7); difference = behavioural minus contractual.

zero_rates_at_midpoints.description: Zero rate at each bucket midpoint, bucket 1 first.

c14Curve.description: The US Treasury par yield curve of the valuation date, bootstrapped to continuously compounded zero rates and read at the 19 midpoints. Tenors the date lacks are listed, never filled silently (dossier 08 C.2).

c14Data.description: The call reports read for the valuation date. Never one dated after it: data_cutoff is the latest report date read and is on or before the valuation date (a producer test checks the dates; a false flag fails).

c14DepositBeta.description: Deposit beta (pass-through of the market rate to the client rate), asymmetric in the direction of the move.

asset_value.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

liability_value.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

equity_change_100bp_up.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14DurationGap.description: Duration gap DGAP = D_A - (L / A) D_L and the first-order change in equity for +100 bp, -DGAP x A x 0.01 (dossier 05 D.2).

c14DynItem.description: One item of the dynamic NII projection (the inputs of simulate_nii): a reset rate is spread + beta x r_t; reprice_months 0 reprices every month, k >= 1 keeps rate0 until month k and resets every k months.

short_rate_path.description: Annual short rate of each projected month, after the floor.

monthly_nii.description: NII of each projected month, money.

total.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_vs_base.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14DynScenario.description: The projected NII under the base path or one parallel shock; delta_vs_base = base total minus this total (loss-positive).

c14DynScenarios.description: base, parallel-up, parallel-down, in that order.

c14DynamicNii.description: Ladder rung 5 (dossier 05 D.6): the monthly NII over 12 to 36 months under the base path and the two parallel shocks of the 2024 calibration, run-off replaced under the stated balance-sheet assumption, deposit betas in the items. Every path and monthly NII has horizon_months values.

Deterministic: the product version and the catalog's SHA-256 identify it, no wall-clock time. The states and what each surface does with them: docs/contracts/catalog.md, section Missing-data states.

catalog_sha256.description: SHA-256 of docs/contracts/catalog.md (its UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalised to LF) the document was computed from.

common-source-details.title: Source details
common-source-details.description: What the Context view shows of one source, from the source registry.

common-source-registry.title: Source registry
common-source-registry.description: Catalog row source-registry 1.0.0: the hand-kept registry of every data source the product knows (data-pipeline/config/sources.json) with its licence class, access and fetch plan. doi and attribution are absent for a source that has none.

researched.description: The date the registry was researched.

common-test-result.title: Test result
common-test-result.description: One validation test row, the record riskvalidation writes as TestResult. extras is open by design.

common-text.title: Text
common-text.description: A bilingual reader-facing string (English and Spanish), as every reader-facing string is at the source.

common-variant-envelope.title: Variant envelope
common-variant-envelope.description: The keys every variant artifact shares (abstract base: a case variant schema composes it with its own outputs). outputs is open here and closed by the case; its optional string kind selects the case schema.

expected.description: The expected range in words, as a rejection states it.

status.description: The catalog's design status: real once the real producer serves the row, active while its provider does.

provenance.description: What actually served the row in this build; null when nothing did (state missing).

reason.description: Why the state is not available; null only when it is.

missing.description: For partial: what is absent (file paths, rejected record ids). Empty otherwise.

retrieved.description: The date the file was retrieved.

fndAnchor.description: The quantitative anchor: the cited test row's statistic or metric, with its unit and the pointer it was read from.

deadline_days.description: Days from the raised date to the due date, by severity (rows) and tier 1 to 4 (columns). No regulatory source prescribes days.

fndCounts.description: The counts by case, severity and status.

fndRisk.description: Risk acceptance of a stated limit of a synthetic case (W15-5): no approver and no expiry exist, each with its reason.

entry_key.description: The inventory entry (case_id/fit_id) the finding belongs to.

rwea_share.description: A decimal share of RWEA (0.05 is 5 percent); non-null only where the anchor's metric is stated as a share of RWEA or as an RWEA amount (W15-11). Computed by riskvalidation.governance.findings.rwea_share_of_anchor.

fndRow.description: One finding of one variant, enriched with the B.7 fields from committed values (R3, W15-5).

govAsOfBasis.description: Why the as-of date is the date it is (W15-13). Production rule: the date of the newest release heading of CHANGELOG.md when the bake runs, never earlier than a raised date. A fixture states that its date is chosen to exercise the overdue rule.

govDate.description: An ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). The dates of a governance document are deterministic: the as-of date and every raised date come from committed values (R4 of the U15 sizing); a wall-clock date never enters a document.

basis.description: The decision or finding of the record that raises it.

govGovFinding.description: A governance finding of the inventory itself (W15-3: the rubric blind spot, S3; W15-4: independence not established, S2).

code_version.description: The Contraste code version that wrote the document.

riskvalidation_version.description: The engine version that computed it.

generators.description: The writer of the document; a fixture is labelled fixture:u15-s-contracts.

ref.description: The git ref and commit the bytes were read from when the document is not on the branch the bake runs on (the C18 documents of the fixture); null otherwise.

documents_read.description: Every case document read, with the sha256 of its bytes (line endings normalised to LF) and its git ref.

govProvenance.description: Where a governance document came from: code and engine versions and the sha256 of every case document it read.

governance-governance-appetite.title: Governance model risk appetite
governance-governance-appetite.description: Catalog row governance-appetite 1.0.0: the model risk appetite metrics of 06 B.6 (data/derived/governance/appetite.json), each with its value, unit, numerator, denominator and a light under a stated convention threshold.

governance-governance-findings.title: Governance findings register
governance-governance-findings.description: Catalog row governance-findings 1.0.0: the findings register across cases (data/derived/governance/findings.json): one row per case_id/variant_id/id with the product severity and its ECB F equivalent, the mapped B.7 status, the evidence, the anchor, the owner role, the raised and due dates, the ageing, the overdue flag, the remediation and the risk acceptance, with the counts.

governance-governance-inventory.title: Governance inventory
governance-governance-inventory.description: Catalog row governance-inventory 1.0.0: the model inventory of Contraste's own case models (data/derived/governance/inventory.json): one entry per fit (case_id/fit_id) with the 40 B.2 attributes, the components, the scope record, the tier block, the lifecycle state, the schedule dates, the dependency edges, the engine node and the governance findings of the inventory itself.

governance-governance-report.title: Governance validation report
governance-governance-report.description: Catalog row governance-report 1.1.0: the I.3 validation report of one inventory entry (data/derived/governance/reports/<case>-<fit>.json): twelve sections, each filled from the inputs it names or absent with its reason; section 11 holds the opinion level 1 to 4, the rule that gave it and the recommendation, labelled the rule's output.

entry_key.description: The inventory entry (case_id/fit_id) the report is for.

invAttr.description: A B.2 attribute: never a bare value. basis is the JSON pointer read, or the convention's or the absence's reason.

invAttributes.description: The 40 attributes of 06 B.2 (l.539-551), keyed A01 to A40.

invComplexity.description: C from the factor scores: the mean rounded half up, and the maximum. A factor with a null score is unscored, with its reason.

key.description: case_id/fit_id/model_id: model ids repeat across cases, so the key is the triple.

invConventions.description: The tables that are conventions (item 30 of the dossier UNVERIFIED list): named parameters, each labelled convention with its basis.

invEdge.description: A dependency (W15-8): a document read or a code import, with its stated source. Kept apart from the related links.

invEngineNode.description: The engine node every entry depends on (W15-8); its key is never an entry key.

variant_id.description: Null when the whole case is left out; a variant id when only that variant has no determinable fit (W15-15).

invExcluded.description: A case, or one variant of a case, left out of the inventory, with the reason (missing-data behavior).

share.description: The share of the stated balance; null where no balance exists.

invLifecycle.description: The B.4 lifecycle state; use before validation only with an exception record (type, approver, expiry).

invMap.description: The layered layout of the dependency map (the bake's networkx layout, a geometry and not a model value).

invMateriality.description: M = max(exposure band, regulatory use, decision criticality), under both readings of regulatory use.

invOverride.description: An override of the computed tier: a rationale and an approver are required, never silent (SS1/23 Principle 1.3(d)(e)).

invRelated.description: A link that is not a dependency: a page statement, a shared method, a shared source (A D4 5.1, 5.3).

invSchedule.description: The next review, full revalidation and monitoring dates from the tier and the frequency table (06 B.8).

invScope.description: The B.1 scope record: the four answers and the in-scope decision per jurisdiction profile (06 l.523-537).

invTier.description: The tier block: M, C, the factor scores with their tags, the tier, the override and the tier under the four readings.

invVariant.description: A variant document of the entry and the provenance rule that assigned it (W15-15): the fit whose sources the variant's provenance reads, or the single models document of the case. A variant whose fit cannot be determined is in excluded.

regulatory-calculators.title: Regulatory calculators
regulatory-calculators.description: The official worked examples (the five CRE99 SA-CCR netting sets from their trades, the RBC20.13 output floor) and the invariant cases (BA-CVA, the FRTB SBM aggregation with its cross-bucket fallback, the liquidity-horizon cascade) of the regulatory calculators run through the engine, the output-floor phase-in, the parameter tables and a CRE20 lookup grid, each with its paragraph and in-force date. The live ports of the regulation page are held to this document at 1e-9 relative.

regulatoryEngine.description: The engine release that produced the outputs.

paragraph.description: The paragraph (or the first paragraph of a range) of the rule.

regulatoryEntry.description: A calculator entry of the regulation page: the trades (for an SA-CCR example), the inputs, the engine's outputs, the values the framework publishes, the paragraph and the in-force date of the chapter. The live ports are held to it at 1e-9 relative.

regulatoryGridRow.description: One cell of the CRE20 lookup grid, keyed as the engine's standardised.lookup(exposure_class, key, short_term, cash_flow_dependent, counterparty_weight): the risk weight as a decimal, the band as the table prints it, the table, its paragraph and the in-force date of the chapter. For an LTV band the key is a representative LTV (the upper edge, or 1.5 above 1.0 and 1.0 above 0.8).

regulatoryParameterRow.description: One parameter of a regulatory table: the row key, the parameter's name, its value and its unit.

regulatoryParameterTable.description: A parameter table the live ports display (CRE52.72 Table 2, MAR50.16 Table 1, MAR33.4 Table 1, MAR33.12 Table 2), with its paragraph and the in-force date of the chapter.

regulatoryPhaseIn.description: One row of the output-floor phase-in (RBC90.1 Table 1): the year, the date it applies from and the floor factor.

regulatoryPublished.description: A value the framework publishes for a worked example (for example the EAD after rounding to an integer, or the multiplier to three decimals); it must equal the recomputed output rounded as stated.

regulatoryTrade.description: One trade of a worked example with its contractual terms as values (strings for currency, position and option type), transcribed from the CRE99 table with its paragraph.

money.const: as stated per value (USD thousands for CRE99, index points for RBC20.13)

regulatoryUnits.description: Units of every number, per value.

value.description: A number, a string (a currency, a position, an option type, an entity) or an array of numbers (a vector or a matrix in row-major order).

paragraph.description: The paragraph this value comes from, for example CRE52.23.

regulatoryValue.description: One named value: an input or an output, with its unit, the paragraph it comes from and its basis: transcribed from a source line, recomputed from the inputs by the engine's formulas, or constructed by the fixture for an invariant.

repInput.description: An input a section names (A D5).

repMissing.description: An element of the I.3 template the product holds nothing behind (A D5, the Missing column).

rwea_share.description: The register row's share, carried unchanged. Computed by riskvalidation.governance.findings.rwea_share_of_anchor.

en.const: the rule's output on the evidence; Contraste approves no model

repOpinion.description: Section 11: the ECB four-level opinion, the rule that gave it, the open findings it was computed on and the labelled recommendation.

kind.description: spec(test_id).decision of the engine registry (W15-12): p_value or metric. Computed by riskvalidation.governance.policy.resolve_policy.

direction.description: Read from the policy file where one resolves; null for an inline battery string. Computed by riskvalidation.governance.policy.resolve_policy.

repPolicy.description: The policy identity of a test row (W15-6, W15-12): a packaged label through the policy file, a packaged label computed with other cut points (`<label>+custom`, source packaged-policy-overridden), an inline battery string parsed, or unresolved with its reason.

repSection11.description: I.3 section 11: Overall opinion and recommendation (06 l.1219-1237).

repSection2.description: I.3 section 2: Model description and intended use (06 l.1219-1237).

repSection5.description: I.3 section 5: Implementation and process verification (06 l.1219-1237).

repSection7.description: I.3 section 7: Sensitivity, robustness and stress (06 l.1219-1237).

repSection9.description: I.3 section 9: Limitations and compensating controls (06 l.1219-1237).

cases.description: The case ids that read the source.

unverified.description: What about the source is not yet verified on a primary page.

state.description: available: the real producer answered. partial: some of it exists (missing lists the rest). stale: an older bake answered (reason says how old). provider: the row's provider answered (provenance says which kind). training: a model slot answered with the released model or the baseline while a newer model trains, or with the baseline while no released model exists. missing: nothing answered.

text.description: Every reader-facing string is bilingual at the source.
